# ==============================================================================
# SCRIPT: Aligned Rank Transform (ART) 2-Way ANOVA with Post-Hoc Contrasts
# Package: ARTool
# ==============================================================================

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(ARTool)
library(emmeans)
```

```{r}
file_path <- "eeg_datatable_082126.xlsx"
raw_data <- read_excel(file_path, na = c("", "NA", "N/A", "n/a", "nan", "NaN"))

data_clean <- raw_data %>%
  # Filter out true NAs and any literal string matches
  filter(!is.na(Group) & !str_to_lower(str_trim(Group)) %in% c("", "n/a", "na", "nan")) %>%
  mutate(
    Animal = factor(Animal),
    # Separate 4 groups into 2x2 factorial factors
    Injury = factor(if_else(str_detect(Group, "TBI"), "TBI", "Sham"), levels = c("Sham", "TBI")),
    SDs = factor(if_else(str_detect(Group, "\\+SD"), "SD", "Saline"), levels = c("Saline", "SD")),
    Group = factor(Group, levels = c("Sham", "Sham+SD", "TBI", "TBI+SD"))
  ) %>%
  # Drop any leftover unused factor levels
  droplevels()
```


```{r}
run_art_analysis_2WAY <- function(data, dv_index, adjust = "fdr") {
  dv_cols_local <- names(data)
  dv_name <- dv_cols_local[dv_index]
  
  cat("=======================================================\n")
  cat(sprintf("ANALYSIS FOR: %s (DV Index: %d, Column: %s)\n", 
              dv_name, dv_index, names(data)[dv_index]))
  cat("=======================================================\n\n")
  
  # Step A: Ensure DV is numeric
  data_subset <- data
  data_subset[[dv_name]] <- as.numeric(as.character(data_subset[[dv_name]]))
  
  # Step B: Report and drop excluded animals
  dropped_animals <- data_subset %>%
    filter(is.na(.data[[dv_name]])) %>%
    pull(Animal)
  
  if (length(dropped_animals) > 0) {
    cat(sprintf("Dropped %d animal(s) due to NA in %s: %s\n\n", 
                length(dropped_animals), dv_name, paste(dropped_animals, collapse = ", ")))
  } else {
    cat("No animals dropped due to missing values.\n\n")
  }
  
  # Subset clean data with complete values for this DV
  analysis_df <- data_subset %>% 
    filter(!is.na(.data[[dv_name]])) %>%
    droplevels()
  
  cat(sprintf("Final sample size for analysis: %d animals\n\n", nrow(analysis_df)))
  
  if (nrow(analysis_df) < 4) {
    cat("Insufficient data points to perform ART ANOVA.\n\n")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  
  # Step C: Summary of Mean, SD, Median, and IQR per group
  summary_stats <- analysis_df %>%
    group_by(Group, Injury, SDs) %>%
    summarise(
      N = n(),
      Mean = mean(.data[[dv_name]], na.rm = TRUE),
      SD = sd(.data[[dv_name]], na.rm = TRUE),
      Median = median(.data[[dv_name]], na.rm = TRUE),
      IQR = IQR(.data[[dv_name]], na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  cat("--- DESCRIPTIVE SUMMARY TABLE ---\n")
  print(as.data.frame(summary_stats))
  cat("\n")
  
  # Step D: Fit 2-Way Factorial ART Model (Injury * SDs)
  cat("--- 2-WAY FACTORIAL ALIGNED RANK TRANSFORM (Injury * SDs) ---\n")
  # Standardized column reference so ARTool builds model formula cleanly
  analysis_df$DV_target <- analysis_df[[dv_name]]
  
  art_model <- art(DV_target ~ Injury * SDs, data = analysis_df)
  art_anova <- anova(art_model)
  print(art_anova)
  cat("\n")
  
  # Step E: Pairwise Group Comparisons with ART & Multiple Testing Adjustment
  cat(sprintf("--- PAIRWISE GROUP COMPARISONS (%s Adjusted) ---\n", toupper(adjust)))
  
  # 1. Full 4-Group interaction pairwise contrasts
  cat("[1] Group-by-Group Pairwise (Injury:SDs combinations):\n")
  post_hoc_groups <- art.con(art_model, "Injury:SDs", adjust = adjust)
  print(summary(post_hoc_groups))
  cat("\n")
  
  # 2. Main Effect Contrasts
  cat("[2] Main Effect of Injury (Sham vs TBI):\n")
  post_hoc_injury <- art.con(art_model, "Injury", adjust = adjust)
  print(summary(post_hoc_injury))
  cat("\n")
  
  cat("[3] Main Effect of SDs (Saline vs SD):\n")
  post_hoc_sds <- art.con(art_model, "SDs", adjust = adjust)
  print(summary(post_hoc_sds))
  cat("\n")
  
  return(invisible(list(
    model = art_model,
    anova = art_anova,
    post_hoc_groups = post_hoc_groups,
    post_hoc_injury = post_hoc_injury,
    post_hoc_sds = post_hoc_sds,
    summary = summary_stats,
    data = analysis_df,
    dv_name = dv_name
  )))
}
```

```{r}
results_art <- run_art_analysis_2WAY(
  data = data_clean, 
  dv_index = 8,      # Replace with your DV index
  adjust = "fdr"
)
```
